errors.description: A dark garment — a black shirt or jacket with a visible button — intrudes across the top edge of the frame above the waistband. The attempt-2 finding was a pair of black oxford shoes at the bottom; those are gone, and this is the same class of fault at the other end.
errors.expected: trouser leg only, from the waistband down, with no other garment in frame
errors.actual: the waistband is clean but a black upper garment occupies the top ~4% of the frame
errors.correction: Accepted at this attempt. It is dark-on-dark, sits entirely outside the craft option, and does not compete with or obscure the braid. Recorded rather than waved through.

errors.description: The supplier file names 1.2 cm. The braid is proportionate to the waistband depth and belt loops and is consistent with 1.2 cm, but there is no scale reference in frame to measure it against.
errors.actual: a braid of plausible and proportionate width, not independently measurable
errors.correction: Accepted as a limit of the format. Noted so the claim is not overstated.

errors.description: In the upper third the braid sits a few millimetres forward of the outseam line rather than centred on it; lower down it converges onto the seam correctly.
errors.expected: the braid centred on the outseam for its full length
errors.actual: a slight forward offset near the hip, correct from mid-thigh down
errors.correction: Accepted. The offset is within the drape distortion of a worn garment photographed in three-quarter profile and does not change which seam the braid belongs to.

lockedFeatures: a single continuous satin braid running the full visible length of the outseam
straight, unbroken, with crisp parallel edges
genuine MATERIAL contrast — lustrous flat satin against open matte wool, two cloths meeting at a hard edge
black-on-black tonal treatment, no invented colour
no shoes, no ankle, no floor, no floor shadow
zero traced annotation: no numbers, no leader lines, no arrows, no 1.2 cm callout
notes:
ATTEMPT 3. The attempt-2 findings were three minors and no critical or major, so the correction targeted exactly those.

The substantive win is the material contrast. At attempt 2 the braid read 'mainly as a sheen line rather than as an obviously different cloth' — which is the whole point of the option, since a customer choosing a satin side stripe is buying a second material, not a highlight. Instructing the render to show two cloths MEETING AT A HARD EDGE, rather than asking for more contrast in the abstract, produced an unambiguous satin band against matte wool.

The attempt-2 composition fault (black oxford shoes and floor at the bottom of the frame) is fixed. A smaller instance of the same class appeared at the top instead — a dark upper garment across the top edge — and is logged rather than ignored, though it is dark-on-dark, outside the option, and obscures nothing.

All nine categories at or above 95 with zero Critical or Major findings, so this qualifies for the logged waiver at attempt 3.
